claim_summary: TimeCAP contributes a fixed task-specific workflow using frozen LLM prompts for time-series contextualization, prediction, and rationales, a trained multimodal encoder, nearest-neighbor in-context retrieval, and prediction fusion.

claim_evidence.quote: To address this limitation, T IME CP introduces two independent LLM agents, AC and AP , which aim to better leverage the contextualization capabilities of LLMs for time series event prediction.
